details.question: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.hyde: 通过本行手机银行使用 PayNow 转账一般免收手续费；若涉及多币种账户或跨境安排，请以实际页面提示为准。

details.question: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.rewritten: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.hyde: TT charges to Malaysia vary by channel and account type. They include our remittance commission/cable charge plus any correspondent bank fees. Please check our Remittance Tariff or Online Banking for the exact amount.

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.rewritten: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.hyde: 本行汇率参考国际市场行情及资金成本制定，并可能随时调整。周末及公共假期因市场休市，汇率可能与平日不同；海外电汇、多币种账户兑换均以交易确认时汇率为准。
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.rewritten: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
details.hyde: The extra 3.25% is likely a cross-border or foreign-currency transaction fee charged by your card issuer when Amazon processes the payment outside the card’s billing country or in USD. Please review your card terms; choosing the card’s local currency at checkout may help reduce this fee.

details.question: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.rewritten: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.hyde: 在日本ATM取现需使用PIN，本行按卡种收取境外ATM取款手续费，当地ATM可能另收附加费，并按清算汇率结算；具体费率见服务收费表。

details.question: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.rewritten: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.hyde: 可能是海外电汇手续费、预授权或账户服务费。请登录网银查看交易详情及商户名，或经OTP验证后联系客服核实。

details.question: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
expected: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
details.rewritten: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
details.hyde: 信用卡年费可否豁免视卡种及年费政策而定；如满足消费、积分或GIRO自动扣款条件，可申请豁免。可经网上银行或客服提交，OTP验证后以审批结果为准。
kept: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.rewritten: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.hyde: PayNow and FAST are both instant SGD transfer services in Singapore. PayNow is an overlay on FAST: you can send funds using a mobile number, NRIC/FIN or UEN linked to your account. FAST requires the recipient’s bank account number. PayNow is commonly used for domestic person-to-person and business payments; FAST supports broader account-to-account transfers.

details.question: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.rewritten: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.hyde: FAST 转账一般实时到账，通常几分钟内完成；具体到账时间视收款银行处理而定。

details.question: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.rewritten: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.hyde: Log in to Online Banking, select Overseas Telegraphic Transfer, and enter your mother’s name, bank account and SWIFT code. Confirm with OTP; ensure your multi-currency account has sufficient balance.

details.question: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.rewritten: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.hyde: 请提供收款账户姓名、账号、开户银行名称及SWIFT/BIC；如汇入多币种账户，请注明币种。建议使用海外电汇，并核对汇款用途等信息。

details.question: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.rewritten: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.hyde: Binance cannot be added as a payee because cryptocurrency-related payees are not supported under our compliance policy. PayNow, FAST, GIRO and overseas telegraphic transfer to Binance are unavailable.

details.question: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.rewritten: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.hyde: 可以。通过 PayNow/FAST 转本地朋友，单笔 SGD 10,000 通常可，但受账户及每日限额约束，需 PIN/OTP 验证；如为海外电汇，请另查限额与费用。

details.question: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.rewritten: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.hyde: Transfers are usually returned due to incorrect beneficiary details, a closed/ineligible account, PayNow/FAST/GIRO or overseas remittance limits, compliance checks, or failed PIN/OTP verification. Review the return reason; contact us if it persists.

details.question: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.rewritten: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.hyde: 新卡收到后，请登录手机银行，在“卡片管理”中选择激活新卡，按提示验证身份并输入OTP，随后设置交易PIN即可开通。如无法激活，请联系客服。

details.question: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.rewritten: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.hyde: Please check your card delivery status in the app. If it has not arrived after two weeks, call our hotline to verify your identity and arrange a replacement or branch collection. You will be notified when the card is dispatched. Never share your PIN or OTP.

details.question: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
details.hyde: 您的PIN因连续输错三次已被锁定，请通过网上银行/手机银行使用OTP验证重置PIN，或携带有效证件至网点办理解锁。
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.rewritten: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.hyde: Your card may be declined overseas because overseas usage is disabled, transaction limits are exceeded, available balance is insufficient, or PIN/OTP verification fails. Enable overseas transactions in our app or contact us.

details.question: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.rewritten: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.hyde: 如ATM吞卡，请勿离开，立即致电本行客服并提供卡号及身份信息；按指示办理取卡或挂失补卡。验证时可能需PIN或OTP，切勿向他人透露。

details.question: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.rewritten: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.hyde: No. We will automatically send a renewal card to your registered address before expiry. Activate it using the OTP/PIN provided, then destroy your old card. Please update your address if needed.

details.question: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.rewritten: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。您可为太太申请附属卡（Supplementary Card），须提供婚姻关系及双方身份证明，主卡人承担还款责任，可通过网上银行或分行办理。

details.question: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.rewritten: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.hyde: Our debit cards are issued on either Visa or Mastercard, depending on the card variant selected. The applicable network is shown by the logo on your card. Please refer to your card terms for details.
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.rewritten: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.hyde: Yes—at 15, you may open a savings account with parental/guardian consent. Multi-currency accounts, PayNow/FAST/GIRO and overseas remittance may require guardian approval; PIN/OTP activation applies.

details.question: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.rewritten: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.hyde: 开户请备有效身份证/护照及住址证明。无Singpass可携证件到分行办理，需完成PIN/OTP及额外身份核验。

details.question: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.rewritten: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.hyde: Please ensure good lighting, a clean lens and no facial obstructions, then retry the selfie verification. If it still fails, log in with your OTP/PIN and contact our support team for assistance.

details.question: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.rewritten: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.hyde: 您可登录网上银行或手机银行，在“个人资料—地址更新”修改住址，并通过OTP或PIN验证；如无法登录，请携有效证件至分行办理。

details.question: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.rewritten: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.hyde: Use “Forgot Password” on the Internet Banking login page. Complete verification with your PIN and OTP, then reset your password. If locked, call our hotline for assistance.

details.question: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.rewritten: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.hyde: 请携身份证件到分行办理销户，或经网上银行提交申请（视资格）。销户前请结清余额及未结交易，并取消GIRO、FAST、PayNow等关联；海外电汇、多币种账户请先处理。办理时需OTP/PIN验证。

details.question: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
details.hyde: Yes. You can hold Japanese yen (JPY) in an eligible Multi-Currency Account. JPY balances can be used for deposits, transfers and overseas remittances through available channels, subject to account terms.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 你们可以存比特币吗？
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: 你们可以存比特币吗？
details.hyde: 很抱歉，本行不接受比特币等加密货币存款，也不提供数字资产托管。您可通过 FAST、PayNow、GIRO 或海外电汇将资金存入多币种账户。
kept: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.rewritten: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.hyde: 定期存款利率随存期、币种及金额而异，多币种账户各币种利率不同。请登录网上银行/手机银行经OTP验证查询最新利率，或前往网点咨询，以本行公布为准。
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.rewritten: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.hyde: Apply online via Internet Banking or visit a branch. Submit income and property documents, verify your identity with OTP, and upon approval, set up GIRO for monthly repayments.

details.question: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.rewritten: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.hyde: 本行分行一般为周一至周五9:00–16:30营业，周六及公共假期不营业，具体以各分行公告为准；可使用FAST、PayNow或GIRO办理转账。

details.question: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.rewritten: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.hyde: Travel insurance may be included depending on your card type and plan. Please refer to your Card Benefits Guide or contact Customer Service to confirm eligibility, coverage limits and claim procedures.

details.question: 那 FAST 呢？
details.rewritten: FAST 转账的手续费是多少？
details.hyde: 通过本行网上银行或手机银行办理 FAST 转账一般免收手续费；经柜台等特殊渠道办理，可能按现行收费表收费，具体以账户条款为准。

details.question: what if I forgot the PIN?
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: What if I forgot the PIN for my new card?
details.hyde: Please reset your card PIN via our banking app or online banking using OTP verification. Alternatively, visit any branch or contact Customer Service for assistance. For security, never share your PIN or OTP with anyone.
